item.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
item.description:
Preparation

Started preparing for the certification on the 2nd week of January and took the exam on 1st February. Went through a ~14 hour long udemy course, alongside with the 6 additional practice exam. Result: 820 (82%)

Thoughts

Udemy Course review

The Udemy course by Stephane Maarek covered a wide variety of AWS services and contain quite a large amount of details. The content of the course goes beyond the certification and it serves as a very good introduction to AWS services. On the same note, a good portion of the content/details are not necessarily useful for the exam.

item.title: Hanyang Exchange - Pre-departure
item.description:
Exchange!!! Consolidated some information which might be useful for those going to hanyang for exchange in the future.

Housing

To understand more about housing in Korea, this article provides good information on the different types of housings in Korea. We opted for housing outside as dormitory are not guaranteed. I found the housings for those of us going to hanyang from this site called goshipages. We will be staying at a place called cozytel near hanyang.

item.title: Internship - ADSC
item.description: During Summer 2019, I embarked on a 16-week internship at Advanced Digital Sciences Center (ADSC) as a Junior Research Assistant. I developed an eclipse plug-in for XSTAMPP which implements the STLSA process. XSTAMPP (eXtensible STAMP Platform) is an open-source platform for safety engineering. STLSA Process is a safety engineering model.

item.title: CDDC2019 - Brainhack
item.description:
Cyber Defender Discovery Camp (CDDC) is a Cyber Security Event organised by the Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA).

About the event

The programme started with a 3 weeks online training on immersive labs followed by an online qualifier for the finals.

item.title: Digital Predix Hackathon 2018
item.description:
The Digital Predix Hackathon was held from July 2018 until 20th Sep 2018. Together with Jin Kind and Ryan, we joined the hackathon as Ventus and came out as the winner in the renewable catagory.

About the hackathon

In the first month, we went through the Predix Developer Boot Camp to learn about the predix platform. After the training, we were given a month to work on an application using the microservices on the predix platform. Using relevant data, we used analytics services to come up with a prediction model that is displayed on a predix UI that is created. Github Repo
